# Open Encyclopedia of Cognitive Science

> MIT's peer-reviewed, open-access encyclopedia covering neuroscience, psychology, artificial intelligence cognition, and cognitive science research.

The Open Encyclopedia of Cognitive Science (OECS) is a collaborative academic platform that provides freely accessible, peer-reviewed articles on cognitive science topics. It serves researchers, students, and the public interested in understanding how the mind, brain, and artificial systems process information and cognition.

## Core Encyclopedia

- [Open Encyclopedia of Cognitive Science](https://oecs.mit.edu/open-encyclopedia-of-cognitive-science): MIT's open-access encyclopedia of cognitive science with peer-reviewed articles on neuroscience, psychology, and AI cognition.
